title: The Pneumocystoscopic Transurethral Tumorresection using Photodynamic Diagnosis
summary:
The objective of the study is to evaluate the use of air instead of water in transurethral tumor resection using photodynamic diagnostics. For this purpose, the subjects are initially divided into two groups, the first group (comparison group) is examined and operated conventionally using water irrigation in the urinary bladder. In the second group (intervention group) the operation will take place under air filling of the urinary bladder. We expect that the results of the study will lead to improved intraoperative visibility and thus lower complication rates as well as a lower recurrence rate (recurrence of the tumor).

interventions.name: Control with the use of water during the transurethral procedure
Use of air instead of water during the transurethral procedure

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Planned transurethral tumor resection
Exclusion criteria:
Allergy to hexaminolevulinate (Hevix) or indocyanine green (ICG); Planned open or laparoscopic tumor resection.
